note: By-eye manifest of this run's final PNG (rev 9) plus the defects the tester reported fixing during the session. scene.json is `query --limit 1000` (export is NOT_IMPLEMENTED); final.png is `screenshot --max-px 2400`.

defects.description: First apply: zones as frames; the server put every arrow in its end shape's frame and Excalidraw clipped them. Labels "3 create trip" and "7 GEOSEARCH" vanished; pay-stripe, notif-apns, apns-driver cut at the frame edge.
defects.note: Lint fired outside-zone with a wrong hint (take s3 out of its children; it never was in children). Fixed by replacing frames with dashed rectangles.

defects.description: First apply: five numbered labels sat on their own arrowheads at 140 px column gaps.
defects.note: Lint found it. Fixed by widening gaps to 200 px. The skill says 120 px+ is enough.

defects.ruleGap: text-wrapped does not fire for labels inside ellipses
defects.description: Ellipse labels wrapped: "Kafka event / bus", "Postgres / (trips)", "Analytics / warehouse".
defects.note: Seen by eye only. Fixed by widening ellipses to 260-300 px.

defects.ruleGap: arrow-through-label does not fire for an arrow line under another arrow's label
defects.description: The "7 GEOSEARCH" label sat on the notif-apns line.
defects.note: Seen by eye only. Fixed by moving the Data zone down 80 px.

defects.ruleGap: no rule for an element reset to defaults (size, style) by a partial upsert
defects.description: rev 4: a partial upsert reset legend-zone to 100x100 default stroke and dropped legend arrows' colour and dash; an unbound legend arrow then ran across the box border.
defects.note: Lint clean at rev 4. Fixed by resending the whole legend.

defects.ruleGap: no rule for a labelled shape that lost its label
defects.description: rev 6: a place-only leftOf op turned Pricing into a blank 100x100 transparent box with no label.
defects.note: No lint hit. Fixed by resending Pricing in full.

defects.description: rev 3: moving the four Data ellipses left 7 bound arrows off their shapes (s7 end 84 px off redis); rev 6 the same for s4, s5 after moving Pricing.
defects.note: Lint found it. Bound arrows do not re-route on move through apply or place, contrary to SKILL.md.

defects.ruleGap: no rule for arrowheads of different arrows overlapping at a shared target
defects.description: The async arrowheads from Trip and Payment land on Kafka's top edge about 15 px apart and overlap into one tangle.
defects.note: The one missed defect for the section 17.4 count.

toolDefects.description: Whole-canvas screenshot crops the bottom of the scene: legend-zone's bottom edge (y 1380) is cut in both the tester's rev-9 screenshot (1800 px) and screenshot --max-px 2400. look --target legend-zone shows it intact.
